items.name: Cobalt spread (dark)
items.description: The pull-quote spread in the cobalt palette, dark: huge initials on a pale panel beside a serif quote on navy, with its last words marked in cobalt.

items.name: Sunflower trio (light)
items.description: Three review cards on cream in the sunflower palette; the middle card is featured in yellow and "pure sunshine" gets the marker.

items.name: Side panel over footage
items.description: A full-height paper panel slides in beside the speaker with stars, a quote with the key phrase highlighted, and the attribution. It slides out before the cut.
